findings.title: Capped-scan surfacing is log-only on a successful scan
findings.detail: The cap warning flows through onError -> batchErrors -> console.error, but validateFullScan only promotes it to a thrown, UI-visible error when indexing substantially fails (indexed===0 with found>0, >10% unindexed, or firstError with indexed===0). A successful-but-truncated scan logs the warning without raising a status error. This traverses the existing onError path and matches the recorded tradeoff and the brief's wording, so it is informational only and not blocking.
